from types import FunctionType as _FUNCTION_TYPE, CellType as _CELL_TYPE

def admit_provider(provider_path, expected_provider_sha256):
    _check_root()
    source_identity()
    _need(type(expected_provider_sha256) is str and len(expected_provider_sha256) == 64,
          'Bootstrap provider expected digest differs')
    digest, _, source = _hash_regular(provider_path, _MAX_SOURCE, True)
    _need(digest == expected_provider_sha256, 'Bootstrap provider source differs')
    _check_root()
    capability = object.__new__(BootstrapCapability)
    provider = ModuleType('_h25_source_provider_v3_' + str(len(_CAPABILITIES)))
    namespace = provider.__dict__
    namespace.update({'__file__': provider_path, '__builtins__': builtins.__dict__,
        '_TYPE': _TYPE, '_OBJECT': _OBJECT, '_DICT': _DICT, '_TUPLE': _TUPLE,
        '_STR': _STR, '_INT': _INT, '_LEN': _LEN, '_ID': _ID, '_GLOBALS': _GLOBALS,
        '_ERROR': _ERROR, '_OSERROR': _OSERROR, '_OPEN': _OPEN, '_READ': _READ,
        '_FSTAT': _FSTAT, '_CLOSE': _CLOSE, '_SHA256': _SHA256,
        '_FLAGS': _FLAGS, '_PROC_FLAGS': _PROC_FLAGS,
        'BuiltinFunctionType': BuiltinFunctionType, 'CodeType': CodeType,
        'FunctionType': FunctionType, 'ModuleType': ModuleType,
        '_BOOTSTRAP_CAPABILITY': capability, '_ROOT_VALIDATE': _validate_namespace,
        '_ROOT_CREATE': _create_native, '_ROOT_EXEC': _exec_native,
        '_ROOT_ACTIVATE': _activate_native,
        '_MAKE_METADATA_SCOPE': _scope_factory_gate(_NEW_SCOPE)})
    code = _COMPILE(source, provider_path, 'exec', dont_inherit=True, optimize=_OPTIMIZE)
    _check_root()
    _EXEC(code, namespace)
    _check_root()
    _need(type(namespace.get('ProbeBinding')) is type and type(namespace.get('load_probe')) is FunctionType,
          'Bootstrap provider source interface differs')
    guard = _environment_guard(namespace, (namespace['ProbeBinding'],))
    counts = dict(load_calls=0, native_creations=0, native_execs=0, activation_attempts=0,
                  successful_bindings=0, deactivation_attempts=0, cleanup_failures=0, control_module_creations=0)
    _CAPABILITIES[id(capability)] = (capability, provider, guard, digest, provider_path, counts, namespace)
    guard()
    return capability

def _entry():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    _need(len(args) >= 11 and args[0] == '--root-sha256' and args[2] == '--provider' and
          args[5] == '--driver' and args[8] == '--integration' and args[10] == '--',
          'Bootstrap launch argument schema differs')
    initialize(args[1])
    provider_path, provider_sha = args[3], args[4]
    driver_path, driver_sha, integration = args[6], args[7], args[9]
    _need(type(integration) is str and integration.startswith('/') and
          provider_path.rsplit('/', 1)[0] == integration and
          driver_path.rsplit('/', 1)[0] == integration,
          'Bootstrap integration/source directory differs')
    capability = admit_provider(provider_path, provider_sha)
    api = capture_api()
    preflight(capability)  # reject unsupported profile before any driver/build work
    _check_root()
    digest, _, driver_source = _hash_regular(driver_path, _MAX_SOURCE, True)
    _need(digest == driver_sha, 'Bootstrap scientific driver source differs')
    _need(tuple(sys.path) == _INITIAL_PATH, 'Bootstrap initial search path changed before stage installation')
    sys.path.insert(0, integration)
    driver = ModuleType('__main__')
    driver_namespace = driver.__dict__
    driver_namespace.update({'__file__': driver_path, '__builtins__': builtins.__dict__,
                             'bootstrap_root': _ROOT_MODULE,
                             'bootstrap_capability': capability, 'bootstrap_api': api})
    code = _COMPILE(driver_source, driver_path, 'exec', dont_inherit=True, optimize=_OPTIMIZE)
    _check_root()
    sys.argv = [driver_path] + args[11:]
    sys.modules['__main__'] = driver
    _EXEC(code, driver_namespace)

def _initial_native_tcb():
    root, api = _CAPTURED_BOOTSTRAP_ROOT, _CAPTURED_BOOTSTRAP_API
    if (type(EXPECTED_BOOTSTRAP_ROOT_SHA256) is not str or
            _INITIAL_ROOT_IDENTITY != EXPECTED_BOOTSTRAP_ROOT_SHA256 or
            type(NATIVE_TCB_HELPER_SHA256) is not str or len(NATIVE_TCB_HELPER_SHA256) != 64 or
            type(NATIVE_TCB_EXPECTED_FILES) is not tuple or
            type(NATIVE_TCB_EXPECTED_HASHLIB_ORIGIN) is not str):
        raise RuntimeError('Initial native TCB source and expected dependency tuple are not configured')
    helper_path = __file__.rsplit('/', 2)[0] + '/areas/cache-validity/probe-native/native_tcb_v1.py'
    api[0]()
    digest, _, source = root._hash_regular(helper_path, 262144, True)
    if digest != NATIVE_TCB_HELPER_SHA256:
        raise RuntimeError('Initial native TCB helper source differs')
    helper = root.ModuleType('_h25_initial_native_tcb')
    namespace = helper.__dict__
    namespace.update({'__file__': helper_path, '__builtins__': root.builtins.__dict__})
    api[0]()
    code = root._COMPILE(source, helper_path, 'exec', dont_inherit=True, optimize=root._OPTIMIZE)
    api[0]()
    root._EXEC(code, namespace)
    api[0]()
    receipt = namespace['verify_native_tcb'](root, api, NATIVE_TCB_EXPECTED_FILES,
                                               NATIVE_TCB_EXPECTED_HASHLIB_ORIGIN)
    if type(NATIVE_TCB_CONTROLS_SHA256) is not str or len(NATIVE_TCB_CONTROLS_SHA256) != 64:
        raise RuntimeError('Initial native TCB control source pin is not configured')
    control_path = __file__.rsplit('/', 2)[0] + '/areas/cache-validity/probe-native/native_tcb_controls_v1.py'
    api[0]()
    digest, _, control_source = root._hash_regular(control_path, 262144, True)
    if digest != NATIVE_TCB_CONTROLS_SHA256:
        raise RuntimeError('Initial native TCB controls source differs')
    control_namespace = {'__name__': '_h25_initial_native_tcb_controls', '__file__': control_path,
                         '__builtins__': root.builtins.__dict__}
    api[0]()
    control_code = root._COMPILE(control_source, control_path, 'exec', dont_inherit=True, optimize=root._OPTIMIZE)
    api[0]()
    root._EXEC(control_code, control_namespace)
    argv = root.sys.argv
    if (type(argv) is not list or any(type(arg) is not str for arg in argv) or
            argv.count('--output') != 1 or argv.index('--output') + 1 >= len(argv)):
        raise RuntimeError('Early TCB controls require the unique parent --output argument')
    output = argv[argv.index('--output') + 1]
    stage_root = __file__.rsplit('/', 2)[0]
    if (not output.startswith('/') or output.endswith('/') or
            any(part in ('', '.', '..') for part in output.split('/')[1:]) or
            output == stage_root or output.startswith(stage_root + '/')):
        raise RuntimeError('Early TCB controls require a canonical absolute output outside the stage')
    # Parent owns an existing nonsymlink output parent. mkdir is exclusive:
    # a preexisting output, file, or symlink is rejected before any fixture write.
    api[0]()
    root.posix.mkdir(output, 0o700)
    _vraw(output + '/initial-tcb.raw.json', receipt)
    control_directory = output + '/initial-tcb-controls'
    root.posix.mkdir(control_directory, 0o700)
    api[0]()
    controls = control_namespace['run_controls'](
        helper, root, api, NATIVE_TCB_EXPECTED_FILES, NATIVE_TCB_EXPECTED_HASHLIB_ORIGIN, control_directory)
    _vraw(output + '/initial-controls.raw.json', controls)
    if (controls.get('schema') != 'h25-native-tcb-controls-v1' or
            controls.get('expected_records') != 5 or len(controls.get('records', [])) != 5 or
            controls.get('scientific_calls') != 0 or controls.get('probe_native_imports') != 0):
        raise RuntimeError('Initial native TCB control census differs')
    controls['status'] = 'NATIVE_INITIAL_TCB_CONTROLS_PASS'
    api[0]()
    restoration = namespace['verify_native_tcb'](
        root, api, NATIVE_TCB_EXPECTED_FILES, NATIVE_TCB_EXPECTED_HASHLIB_ORIGIN)
    _vraw(output + '/initial-restoration.raw.json', restoration)
    if (type(restoration) is not dict or
            restoration.get('status') != 'MATCHED_DECLARED_INITIAL_NATIVE_FILES' or
            restoration.get('declared_file_count') != len(NATIVE_TCB_EXPECTED_FILES) or
            restoration.get('probe_private_abi_access') is not False):
        raise RuntimeError('Initial native TCB restoration corroboration differs')
    return receipt, controls, output

def _initial_cold_authority():
    root, cap, api = (_CAPTURED_BOOTSTRAP_ROOT, _CAPTURED_BOOTSTRAP_CAPABILITY,
                      _CAPTURED_BOOTSTRAP_API)
    if type(COLD_AUTHORITY_SHA256) is not str or len(COLD_AUTHORITY_SHA256) != 64:
        raise RuntimeError('Initial cold authority source pin is not configured')
    source_path = __file__.rsplit('/', 2)[0] + '/areas/cache-validity/cold_authority_v7.py'
    api[0]()
    digest, _, source = root._hash_regular(source_path, 1048576, True)
    if digest != COLD_AUTHORITY_SHA256:
        raise RuntimeError('Initial cold authority source differs')
    module = root.ModuleType('_h25_initial_cold_authority')
    namespace = module.__dict__
    namespace.update({'__file__': source_path, '__builtins__': root.builtins.__dict__})
    api[0]()
    code = root._COMPILE(source, source_path, 'exec', dont_inherit=True, optimize=root._OPTIMIZE)
    api[0]()
    root._EXEC(code, namespace)
    # The actual source bytes have just executed under the admitted initial
    # interpreter/system-stdlib premise. Capture precedes every candidate import.
    api[0]()
    authority = namespace['capture_authority'](root, cap, api)
    if (type(authority) is not tuple or len(authority) != 7 or
            any(type(entry) is not root.FunctionType for entry in authority)):
        raise RuntimeError('Initial cold authority must expose the sealed seven-entry tuple')
    # Read fresh transport exactly once, before any candidate exposure.
    transport = root.FunctionType.__dict__['__dict__'].__get__(authority[0], root.FunctionType)
    descriptor = transport['_h25_caller_descriptor']
    if type(descriptor) is not tuple or len(descriptor) != 6 or descriptor[1] is not authority:
        raise RuntimeError('Initial cold authority caller descriptor differs')
    return authority, descriptor
